title: Pathways.
officialText:
Where a means of ingress/egress to the property remains open to the public during the course of construction
or demolition, walkways, pathways, and similar areas within the property line that provide a path of travel between the required
means of ingress/egress and the public sidewalk or temporary walkway shall remain open.
